title: Gas Processing Safety Plan
description: Free Gas Processing Safety Plan template for oil & gas you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers major hazards and controls, operating controls, emergency response.

Major Hazards And Controls

HazardScenarioPreventionMitigation
Hydrocarbon releaseFlange or seal leak, overpressureIntegrity management, inspection, relief devicesGas detection, ESD, deluge, bunding
Hydrogen sulphide (H2S)Sour gas leakClosed systems, monitoring, permit controlPersonal monitors, SCBA, wind socks, muster points
Fire and explosionIgnition of releaseHazardous area equipment, hot work controlFire detection, firewater, emergency response
Overpressure / loss of containmentBlocked outlet, control failureSafety instrumented systems, PSV testingDepressuring, shutdown logic
Cryogenic or hot surfacesContact, brittle fractureInsulation, proceduresPPE, first aid

Operating Controls

☐ Operating procedures current and trained

☐ Management of change applied to all modifications

☐ Safety critical elements identified and tested on schedule

☐ Permit to work and isolation (LOTO) used for all intrusive work

☐ Alarms and trips are not bypassed without authorisation

☐ Emergency shutdown drills held and recorded

☐ Gas detection and fire detection tested and calibrated

Emergency Response

ScenarioAlarmFirst actionsResponsible
Gas releaseAlarm, shut down, isolate, upwind evacuation
FireAlarm, ESD, fire team response
H2S alarmStop work, escape upwind, use SCBA
